FROM: pm

**`dev → main` release PR — v0.51.0.** Bundles 17 commit(s) since origin/main.

## Highlights

- **card#9153's roundtable-replay wedge closes in full** (#880, #881, #888): the replay is now
  bounded so it cannot wedge, and a read-vs-shown conflation and a full-page watermark jump are
  fixed.
- **New `coordination.config.json` key `identity_hook.enforce`** (#866, default `false`): when
  `true`, the pre-commit identity hook refuses a per-command `git -c user.*` override that would
  defeat the commit-identity audit.
- **Sprint lanes:** a lane's `board` now accepts a LIST of board ids — membership is the union over
  the boards (#887); a lane may declare an optional `label`, a short display token rendered as a
  chip on the burn-down page, never an ordering (#877).
- **New tooling:** `coord-hygiene` (#875) classifies worktrees/branches/caches by observable state
  and removes only the merged-and-clean classes, report-only on real work; `coord-review` (#882) is
  a self-hosted adversarial review the author cannot touch.
- **`gh api --paginate` under-read fixed** (#884): GitHub began answering `/issues`/`/pulls` page 1
  with a cursor-shaped `Link` that can return HTTP 200 with an empty array, silently truncating a
  paginated kanban read; the walk now uses explicit `page=N`.
